Frequently Asked Questions (Break-Even ROAS)

How do you calculate Break-Even ROAS?

Divide your Average Order Value (AOV) by your Pre-Ad Contribution Margin (AOV minus Landed COGS, shipping/fulfillment, and payment processing fees). For example, a 50% contribution margin requires a 2.00x Break-Even ROAS.

What is the fastest way to lower Break-Even ROAS?

Increase Average Order Value (AOV) with 2-pack bundles or post-purchase 1-click upsells on Shopify, which spreads fixed shipping and gateway costs across higher revenue.
